name: Rin Rokuhara
source: Loves music and is a bit of a gamer. Rin is very relaxed and down to earth most of the time, but can be excitable or moody at other points. Very close with her roommate Futaba; the two often compare each other to sisters. She can be found working at the cafe on weekend mornings.
